text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, increased red cell distribution width, and mild hypoglycemia. Basophilia is also present. These findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or dysfunction, possible infection, and impaired oxygenation. Renal and liver function are within normal limits. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
